title: End cards: a 40px title, bigger loss tiles, a clear Abandoned line
why: The critic scored KIA 3 and Abandoned 2 of 5: the title too small to lead, grey XP line loud, 64px tiles tight to the hero, no focal line on Abandoned. Title 40px, XP line tx-2, tiles 72px with 24px of room, brighter stat rules, the Abandoned loot line in its own 24px bone line. Restyle only, words unchanged.
now: End cards: bigger title and loss tiles, a clear loot line on Abandoned.

edits.replacement: lines.push('Run abandoned. '+'$'+haul.toLocaleString()+' left behind.'); // v28.xx (cw-endcard-clean): the same words, its own bone line (critic on screen 60: no focal line)
